title: indul and érkezik: Departure and Arrival

sections.title: The two verbs of a menetrend
sections.content: indul ("to depart, set off") and érkezik ("to arrive") are the two verbs every menetrend ("timetable") is built from. Both conjugate like any other regular verb you know: Mikor indul a busz? ("When does the bus leave?") Mikor érkezünk? ("When do we arrive?")

items.english: We're arriving exactly on time, we're not late.

sections.content: késik ("to be late") is the word you'll want when a bus doesn't come on time: A busz késik. ("The bus is late.") — it conjugates the same regular way as indul and érkezik.
